'''Steven McCormick''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Quebec Provincial Championship]] in March 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|HDADTJ with TIE fighters, starting Oppressive Enforcement]], according to Dominic Gaudreault's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d413">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-28-quebec-2k-sorry-for-b-tchingd413/ quebec-2k-sorry-for-b-tching], DeckTech (Dominic "Decktech" Gaudreault, 28 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-28-quebec-2k-sorry-for-b-tchingd413/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
